fixture.scope: solo single-Core synthetic FP32 OS v3 axis case

work_and_credit_partition.partition_check: 1 + 63 + 576 = 640 loaded credits; 64 + 576 = 640 consumed credits; epoch-1 initial 1 is carried from first-load epoch, not an additional credit; the compute-epoch boundary resets 0 to 0

compute_consumption_rate.derivation: For each linear Compute segment, progress_rate <= COMPUTE_GATE_capacity / COMPUTE_GATE_work. Thus C_in consumption_rate <= abs(C_in_slope) * capacity / COMPUTE_GATE_work. PRIVATE and other resource rows can only reduce this maximum.

epoch_reset_sensitivity.general_rule: If a credit reset injects unbacked C_in inventory, subtract that injected amount I_reset from the numerator; with R arbitrary boundaries each allowed to inject up to B, use busy >= max(0, (N - (J+1+R)*B)/c_max).
epoch_reset_sensitivity.interpretation: The general theorem needs an epoch-reset correction if resets can create credit. This actual Plan needs no extra B: the only nonzero compute-epoch initial is 1 and matches the previous load endpoint; the next compute epoch is 0 to 0.

on_run_thresholds_for_bound_only.meaning: These are thresholds for this conditional lower-bound test to stop forcing a >5% mismatch (or to fall below the reference), not sufficient run counts for actual acceptance.

assumptions_and_scope.J_definition: Count connected intervals of positive physical HBM load service over the window that supplies these input units; include all hidden LP/tangent/service switches that split an interval.
assumptions_and_scope.description_budget_warning: Seven serialized descriptions or a budget of 8/16 does not by itself prove J<=7/8/16. A separate invariant must bound actual positive-service on-runs.
assumptions_and_scope.binary_switch_mapping: If S is a proved binary on/off transition bound, the existing conservative relation is J<=floor(S/2)+1 depending on initial/end state; J=236 requires at least 470 such transitions in the most favorable endpoint pattern, and possibly more.
assumptions_and_scope.external_events: Solo case only. Concurrent arrivals, phase offsets, competing owners, endpoint activation, or other events must be included in J if they split load-positive service; no concurrent guarantee is computed here.
not_proved: No impossibility claim for all piecewise-affine curves or all representations.
No implication that 236 on-runs would pass the busy criterion; it only makes this lower bound non-decisive.
No change to the positive-service busy metric or the 5% acceptance threshold.
